name: Orca
description: Runs fleets of coding agents in parallel git worktrees, letting you launch Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and others side by side from desktop, mobile or CLI.

skills.name: Parallel Worktrees
skills.description: Spawns each agent in its own git worktree so many coding agents work on the same repo without colliding.

skills.name: Multi-Harness Support
skills.description: Drives Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and dozens of other agent harnesses behind one consistent interface.

skills.name: Issue Tracker Integration
skills.description: Picks up GitHub and Linear issues, assigns them to agents in the fleet and reports progress back to the tracker.
